messages:
emily_csm: Heads up – Renewal for BeaconGrid next week. They've asked invoice be issued to 'BeaconGrid EU Holdings' and want delegated procurement sign (CFO OOO Fri-Mon).
raj_cs: Do we have the new vendor code and VAT? I'll prep amendment once confirmed.
marc_finance: Vendor code: BG-EU-2210. VAT: DE111222333. PO ref: BG-PO-2210. Need billing contact email for the invoice.
emily_csm: Customer gave procurement contact: luca.procure@beacongrid.eu and a delegation letter PDF. They requested a 9-month term with prorated pricing.
theo_sales: Confirmed 9mo okay. Prorated total = EUR 37,950. Customer wants onboarding started after procurement signs (CFO will countersign later).
nina_legal: Delegated signer OK if delegation letter references authority to bind. Add clause: "Delegation reference number" in signature block and an attestation checkbox in envelope. Also prefer "execution date" phrasing.
emily_csm: @docusign_bot can you create envelope: primary = procurement (luca) -> finance (marc_finance) -> legal (nina_legal). Add checkbox text: "I confirm authority per delegation letter" and attach delegation_letter.pdf.
docusign_bot: Draft envelope created env_BG_2210. Routing set. Checkbox added. Link: https://docusign.example/env/env_BG_2210
raj_cs: Updated amendment: entity swap + KMS key fingerprint (customer requested customer-managed keys). Uploaded amendment_v2.pdf to envelope.
nina_legal: Quick edit: replace "signature date" with "execution date" and add delegation ref # DL-2210-07. Approved.
docusign_bot: Envelope env_BG_2210 updated and sent to luca.procure@beacongrid.eu at 2024-09-12T15:30:00Z.
docusign_bot: Signature event: luca.procure signed at 2024-09-12T15:47:12Z. Next recipient: marc_finance.
marc_finance: Signed and uploaded invoice template with VAT fields filled and billing contact luca.accounts@beacongrid.eu.
docusign_bot: Signature event: marc_finance signed at 2024-09-12T16:05:30Z. Next: nina_legal.
nina_legal: Reviewed, small nit: change clause numbering for KMS line. Updated doc. Signing now.
docusign_bot: nina_legal signed at 2024-09-12T16:22:01Z. Envelope completed. Final PDF: https://docusign.example/env/env_BG_2210/final.pdf
theo_sales: Customer confirmed VAT docs uploaded to their procurement portal and onboarding can start after procurement sign.
emily_csm: Marking renewal executed. I'll update the tracker and schedule onboarding kickoff for 2024-09-18. Thanks everyone :tada:
